== Summary ==
Slip “•A Good Friend” cut unchanged from page 8 of the Players Committee's [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-25.pdf Virtual Set 25 release sheet] (PDF file created 10 August 2025), rendered at 200 dpi (pixel box (1112, 75, 1624, 798)). Version [[A Good Friend]] (Original). Not a recreation.
